answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 85 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The nectar register is checked at draw time, dawn lists the eligible set, and zenith seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 85 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker forfeits for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 29 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
